<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_RoboticBurgerSeller" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/robotic-burger-seller">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_StatusUpdate" name="Status update"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_RoboticBurgerSeller">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Robot" name="Robotic burger seller" processRef="Process_Robot"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderToRobot" name="Order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AskMenu" name="Menu or burger?" sourceRef="Task_AskMenu" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AskSides" name="Fries or wedges?" sourceRef="Task_AskSides" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_StatusUpdate" name="Status update" sourceRef="Task_GiveStatusUpdate" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Robot" name="Robotic burger seller" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Order" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Order" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AskMenu" name="Ask whether customer wants menu or just burger"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_MenuChoice_Split" name="Menu or just burger?" default="Flow_BurgerOnly"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_Menu_Split" name="Start menu preparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AskSides" name="Ask whether fries or wedges"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Side_Split" name="Fries or wedges?" default="Flow_Wedges"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Side_Merge" name="Side prepared"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_Menu_Join" name="Menu complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Burger_Merge" name="Burger preparation starts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Timer_StatusUpdate" name="Every 30 seconds" attachedToRef="Task_PrepareBurger" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_StatusUpdate">
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">R/PT30S</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_GiveStatusUpdate" name="Give enthusiastic status update" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StatusUpdate" name="Status update sent"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DeliverConveyor" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Delivered" name="Order delivered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Order" targetRef="Task_AskMenu"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_AskMenu" targetRef="Gw_MenuChoice_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Menu" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gw_MenuChoice_Split" targetRef="Gw_Menu_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wantsMenu}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerOnly" name="Just burger" sourceRef="Gw_MenuChoice_Split" targetRef="Gw_Burger_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gw_Menu_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gw_Menu_Split" targetRef="Task_AskSides"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_AskSides" targetRef="Gw_Side_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fries" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gw_Side_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wantsFries}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wedges" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gw_Side_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gw_Side_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gw_Side_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gw_Side_Merge" targetRef="Gw_Menu_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gw_Menu_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gw_Menu_Join" targetRef="Gw_Burger_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gw_Burger_Merge" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_DeliverConveyor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_DeliverConveyor" targetRef="End_Delivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Timer_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Task_GiveStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_GiveStatusUpdate" targetRef="End_StatusUpdate"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
